positioning.zh: 高级全栈工程师｜AI Agent 工程化
positioning.en: Senior Full-stack Engineer · AI Agent Engineering

projects.name: Agnito

tagline.zh: 代码知识图谱与 AI Agent 工作台，覆盖关系图谱浏览、在线问答与可追溯的执行记录。
tagline.en: A code knowledge-graph and AI Agent workbench for relation-graph exploration, online Q&A, and traceable execution records.

highlights: 构建以代码关系图为核心的知识图谱工作台，使用 React Flow 呈现模块、依赖与证据关系，支持图谱检索、详情追溯及本地仓库知识浏览
设计 NestJS API 与 Agent 在线问答链路，通过 SSE 输出并支持按事件序列恢复；前端以 Last-Event-ID 衔接流式结果
完成 PostgreSQL 持久化设计与实现：以 JSONB 存储问答执行协议和事件数据，通过幂等写入与按凭据/工作区查询支撑可追溯记录
highlightsEn: Built a code knowledge-graph workbench around code relations, using React Flow to present modules, dependencies, and evidence with search, detail tracing, and local-repository exploration
Designed NestJS APIs and the Agent Q&A flow with SSE output and event-sequence recovery; the frontend resumes streams through Last-Event-ID
Designed and implemented PostgreSQL persistence: JSONB stores execution contracts and event data, while idempotent writes and credential/workspace queries support traceable records

projects.name: 智能运维 AI 助手

tagline.zh: 独立全栈交付智能运维 AI 助手,覆盖交互界面、后端服务、工具调用、上下文治理、Prompt 规范和上线机制。
tagline.en: Independently delivered the operations AI assistant end to end, covering UI, backend services, tool calls, context governance, prompt standards, and rollout mechanics.

highlights: 支持 SSE 流式渲染、Markdown / 代码块高亮、上下文操作与工具结果卡片,首 token 延迟低于 300ms
LangChain + Function Calling 集成监控 API、日志检索与知识库检索,将告警研判从 15 分钟压缩到 2 分钟以内
MCP 统一多模型上下文,Prompt 模板与 Few-shot 示例库让结构化输出解析成功率达到 97%
highlightsEn: Delivered SSE streaming, Markdown and code highlighting, context actions, and tool-result cards, with first-token latency under 300ms
Integrated monitoring APIs, log search, and knowledge retrieval through LangChain and Function Calling, reducing alert diagnosis from 15 minutes to under 2 minutes
Used MCP for unified multi-model context; prompt templates and Few-shot examples brought structured JSON parsing to 97%

projects.name: 口腔医学智能平台

tagline.zh: 主导医学端病例工单全流程页面与管理后台,支撑医生、技师、管理员三类角色的差异化权限体系。
tagline.en: Led the full medical ticket workflow and admin console, supporting differentiated permissions for doctors, technicians, and administrators.

highlights: 实现策略配置面板、角色权限管理、审计日志检索与业务数据看板
用链表结构设计动态表单引擎,解决子项依赖父项状态的校验难题,迭代周期缩短约 40%
建设公共设计系统与组件库,抽取私有 npm 包供多子应用复用,消除重复代码约 30%
highlightsEn: Built strategy configuration, role-permission management, audit-log search, and business dashboards
Designed a linked-list-style dynamic form engine for parent-child validation dependencies, shortening iteration cycles by about 40%
Built a shared design system and component library packaged as private npm modules, reducing repeated code by about 30%

projects.name: 医学头影测量系统

tagline.zh: 围绕医学测量和口腔模型建立图形交互能力,处理坐标系、测量计算、模型解析与选区交互。
tagline.en: Built graphics interaction capabilities for medical measurement and oral models, handling coordinate systems, measurement math, mesh parsing, and region selection.

highlights: 使用 react-konva 通过 Group 层级解耦图片坐标系与测量逻辑坐标系,解决缩放时测量值漂移
基于策略模式将差异化测量计算抽象成可组合数学工具链,新增测量项无需修改核心逻辑
引入 vtk.js 解析 .vtp 多边形网格并转换为 BufferGeometry,用 Raycaster 实现精准分区上色与套索选区
highlightsEn: Used react-konva Group layers to decouple image coordinates from measurement coordinates, fixing value drift during scaling
Abstracted measurement calculations into composable strategy-based math tools, allowing new measurement items without changing core logic
Parsed .vtp polygon meshes with vtk.js, converted them to BufferGeometry, and used Raycaster for accurate region coloring and lasso selection

experience.role: 前端技术经理 / 全栈工程师
experience.company: 牙颜(上海)医疗科技有限公司

achievement.zh: 独立全栈交付智能运维 AI 助手(NestJS + React),基于 LangChain + Function Calling 构建多工具 Agent,告警根因定位从 15 分钟压缩至 2 分钟;首 token 延迟 <300ms
achievement.en: Solely delivered an AIOps assistant (NestJS + React); built a multi-tool agent via LangChain + Function Calling, cutting root-cause triage from 15 min to 2 min; first-token latency <300ms
